name: Hubble
quote: Listen to the echoes coming from the void.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Dawn has arrived.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: The sky above is ever-changing.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: The silver glow from the horizon gently envelopes the vast land like soft willow catkin.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: While most are deep in their blissful slumber, thousands of stars are silently ascending from the horizon.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: When night falls, I stand on the steps and listen; stars swarm in the garden, and I stand in darkness.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Look up to the heavens. Faraway in the universe, the stars realign tonight.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: You must be having a dream full of wonders.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: The stars are so beautiful tonight. Would you like to go with me to the observatory and do some stargazing together?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: To what do I owe the pleasure?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Would you like to go stargazing with me?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Is it my turn?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Witness how the stars shimmer, pulsating like passionate hearts amongst the vastness of the galaxy. Astronomer Hubble, at your service.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I can feel the stars pulsating.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: All the stars and planets shall return to their rightful positions.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Drifting among the stars and transcending the shadows of time and space, I seek the truth behind everything.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: I am ready, as you can see.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: I sense a kind of chaotic malevolence.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Astral vessels, tremble with power!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Nothing shall obscure the light.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Mission complete.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: The universe... is collapsing...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: The movement of the universe has its own set of laws. Planets orbit around stars to form the basis of a star system. I suppose many similarities can be found in our relationship now...

voices.label: New Year
voices.text:
Taking a step back from the hustle and bustle is not necessarily a bad thing. It's better to indulge in what you really love instead of simply following the crowd. 
If it pleases you, perhaps I can teach you about stargazing?

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Have you ever seen planet-shaped chocolates like these before? First, you cover brandy chocolate balls with a coat of colored syrup. Once they harden, they look just like tiny little solar systems shining in space.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: I've heard that shooting stars can be seen in Magrasea as well. They say if you wish upon a shooting star during Tanabata, your wish will come true. I am not sure if it's real... but I will give it a try tonight.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Look at the night sky! There are no werewolves, no vampire counts, no flaming pumpkin-heads floating in mid-air. All that remains is a silver glow piercing through the dark clouds and the brilliant twinkling of the stars, always and forever.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Did you know? The Santa Claus we all know that flies around on a sled filled with presents may have actually just been a meteorite passing through our atmosphere.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Since it's your birthday, let's do something fun and meaningful together. We can observe the stars with our naked eyes and telescopes, write down all the fantastical things that we see and then... I'll make tea for two in the afternoon: milk, scones, and two fried eggs. What do you think?

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Zzz...
 ... Be it in 42Lab or elsewhere, isn't it normal to feel sleepy during meetings like this?

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Among the millions of stars that shine, I can feel the melodious pulsation of life and an unshakable will that lurks in the darkness.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: On my bookshelf, I have 2,500 books, 5,000 notebooks, and 12,000 rough sketches. These are the results of my observations and research from the time I was born until now. That big telescope is from an astronomy museum in Europe. I took it with me when I escaped from the war.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Perhaps romanticism and mysticism are what this world is all about.
Some realists will deny it, and maybe they're correct, but don't you think their way of thinking is too boring? Humanity wouldn't have been able to develop to this level without their curiosity and inquisitiveness about the unknown.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Could you stay here with me tonight, Professor?
Tonight, a once-in-a-century comet will be passing close to the Earth. Let us silently witness this miracle together.

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Hmm...

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehe

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Hm?

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: The moon makes its retreat and the sun's crest rears. Whether or not those below see, light always shines in the firmament.

voices.label: Good afternoon
voices.text: The star's halo is truly brilliant, is it not? It is so stark in contrast to the moon's clear light.

voices.label: Good evening
voices.text: The time for supper has come. While the skies remain clear and the winds agreeable, would you partake of this cup of starlight with me, Professor?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: It is late, Professor. The heavens' luster proliferates, and shining dew washes away remnant commotion... enjoy this moment of peace.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Akin to cloud and mist, with the form of amassed stars... this outfit's design is lovely, is it not? I quite like it myself.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Those lights and candles are like a warm, fuzzy ball of light. Perhaps, from afar, they're not unlike a quietly swirling galaxy.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor... are you a little drunk? Hehe... a lively function wears everyone down, I see.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: The feast is not yet over. Would you walk with me beneath this starry sheet?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Do you like this headdress too?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: I wonder how well you hold your drink, Professor...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: What a rich aroma.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: On duty, are we? I ought to go change.

voices.label: Acquisition
voices.text: The day's heavenly phenomena are moving indeed, but this outfit is more fit for the backing of the night sky. Are you prepared to dine together, Professor? I am expectant, to be frank.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: And now, the banquet begins.

voices.label: Start Combat
voices.text: Go. Follow this white rose's aroma.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Heavens, at my command!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: A fog that veils the sky cannot hope to dash away the light of the stars.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Operation complete. Good work, everyone.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: The skies grow dark...

career:
The PSRA model Doll, specializing in astronomy, cosmogony, and astrophysics, was created by the 42Lab in collaboration with the renowned astronomer Dr. Vera, assigned by the World Astronomical Research Union (WARU).

Hubble, the first PSRA model Doll, was created in 2057. Astronomy was regarded as an inferior discipline at that time, and Hubble was not picked among the first group of testing Dolls for Project Neural Cloud. Thanks to her friend Fresnel's support, Hubble was given a second chance and passed the test to enter Magrasea.
infoStories:
Hubble holds a fascination with all kinds of fantasy and sci-fi stories, possibly influenced by her research topics. The wonderful ways she perceives and contemplates the universe are unseen even in humans. A typical example of that would be her great interest in astrology: a mystical discipline traditionally considered superstitious and to be the antithesis of science.

Scientists are expected to use simple expressions. Hubble, on the other hand, prefers to convey her ideas with image evoking expressions—both in life and in work. Hubble's poetic words put a different spin on otherwise mundane life. That is why she has so many friends in 42Lab: The other Dolls all love and enjoy talking with Hubble—even if sometimes her words are a bit too abstract for them to understand.

Dr. Vera, Hubble's immediate manager, adores her and shares sci-fi stories with her. Hubble often provides Vera with a variety of insightful critiques from unusual perspectives, which she has never received from other Dolls.

Vera and Hubble collaborated on a short story once, a fantasy tale about the birth, development, and extinction of an entire galactic system. They anonymously posted it on the 42Lab internal forums, making the learning of astronomy be all the rage among Doll residents.

And it was that certain story that brought Fresnel and Hubble together.

Contrary to popular belief, Hubble's divergent thinking and romantic inclination may not always be a boon; they may occasionally cause her some trouble.

Once immersed in her fantasy world, Hubble speaks like a computer infected with viruses, frequently spouting obscure or even ominous sayings that she is utterly unaware of.

Due to her divergent paradigm, Hubble is averse to the lab's rigid rules, especially those seminars that involve several hours of sitting.

"I am so grateful that Ms. Hubble could show me around. I learned a lot from her patient and kind guidance. We also attended a seminar. I was nervous at first, but I quickly relaxed when I saw Ms. Hubble doze off..."
"Ms. Hubble then slipped me out of the meeting and took me to the observatory to stargaze! I had the impression that researchers were all solemn folks, but Ms. Hubble proved me wrong. Her tour was fantastic!"
—42Lab Open Day Review Letter

Wherever there are people, there are power struggles. Hubble's lab has a small research budget due to the low priority of the subject and its impracticality. Despite this, there are some immoral individuals who seek to take advantage of the lab.

In situations like that, Hubble fearlessly speaks up before Vera can say anything. Her popularity and good image enable her to resolve the majority of these issues.

Despite her difficulties, Hubble never abandons her passion for astronomy. In addition to her desire to travel the cosmos, Hubble holds the belief that the vast beyond is the ultimate destination for all humans and sentient beings.

Ever since her arrival in Magrasea, Hubble was unable to conduct her astronomical observations beyond the Oasis, due to physical restrictions and limited operand for non-emergency projects. She had to construct her own observatory from the ground up. Fortunately, with Fresnel's assistance, she was able to put everything together after much work.

They also managed to build a holographic room that mimics the universe. It serves as a scientific research lab as well as a place for Dolls to unwind after tiring missions. Hubble is often seen working in the room, sometimes jotting down her observations, sometimes engrossed in her thoughts in front of the ever-changing constellations. After she leaves, intriguing, sparkling jewels are frequently found nearby.

"I didn't realize it was already past visiting hours. When I pushed the door open, I saw Fresnel put a gem on a planet."
"That blue gem was a perfect match with the planet's color."
—Research Interview Records from Observatory Mimic Room
oathDesc: Looking toward the source of that twinkling starlight.

projections.name: Skygazer
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"We stare into the deep space on this pale blue dot, breaking ourselves free out of the endless loop of time to venture into the infinite universe."

projections.desc:

"We stare into the deep space on this pale blue dot, breaking ourselves free out of the endless loop of time to venture into the infinite universe."

projections.name: Lost Starlight
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"In the midst of the endless dark silence, we could only see the starlight shining on us."

skinList.name: Lovely Star-Dusted Night
skinList.desc:
"Roar In The New" Series — This is Cyber Media's Year of the Tiger-themed fashion collection, combining classic elements with a pursuit of new trends.
"The light of the stars will never fade wherever you go. If you've never seen the starlight in the heavens before, then you might as well look straight ahead instead."

skinList.name: Astral Brilliance
skinList.desc: The first awakening of a Doll has the same level of importance as birth to a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection—"The light of the heavens awakens the constellations, and thus the sun and moon shine in unison — just like our first encounter. Before the orbit of duty begins to turn, can you take me to see the night sky that will bear my fate?"

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
The Dolls reveal their true natures by accident, and take new forms with the aid of a mysterious power. Where truth and falsehood intersect, beware of drowning in a fool's game.
"The stars are so far away... Can the speed of my thoughts catch up... with them... zzz..."

skinList.name: Star-questing Sorcerer
skinList.desc:
From the "Providential Evening" series — the Dolls' wardrobe on Christmas. The stars sparkle above the snowy night. She rides her broom into the sky, bringing the stars the presents she has made for them.
"The stars' wishes show themselves in the lovely courses they trace, and my mission is to give them their Christmas presents."

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"The light of the sea sparkle and the twinkling of the stars are like fading dreams, bound to eventually fade away. That is why we must properly savor this brief, wonderful present."

skinList.name: Ever-Radiant Star
skinList.desc:
The "Gala Dreams" series—Countless colors weave together to create resplendent dreams on this memorable evening ball, which slowly blends into the shades of the night.
 The night wind slowly drowns out the lantern light, interspersed by the rustling of grass and the chirping of insects. The moon is bright, drowning all in its light, and you are my closest star.
"The day will come when the heavens will send their congratulations, when two gazes from across the starry firmament surpass the vast and ancient depths of the sky, and the world bears witness to how the paths of two shining stars cross at last.
